fusions.name: Clamped Shut
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that clamps the tines shut for 10 piercing damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lunge from the Bank
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 6 tiles away for 22 piercing damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Sunken Jaws
fusions.desc: Sets a jaw of tines by the nearest enemy that waits for up to 60 seconds. The first enemy to come within 3 tiles springs it, and it deals 20 damage to everything within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Basking Hour
fusions.desc: When you return to full health, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
